title: Kokoro mlx_audio Japanese TTS + HyperFrames narrated-video pipeline guidance
summary: Codified reading rules for misaki cutlet G2P (write kana/katakana, never pyopenjtalk on 82M-4bit), the whisper round-trip verification gate, and registered the narrated-explainer-video template + voice.mlx_audio_kokoro backend.
hint_triggers: Japanese Kokoro synthesis via mlx_audio uses misaki cutlet G2P: Latin alphabet passes through unphonemized (AI→あい) and no pitch-accent marks are emitted (flat intonation). Write readings in kana/katakana (エーアイ, だいさんい, みっつ) and lint predicted phonemes before synthesis. JAG2P version=pyopenjtalk verified worse on Kokoro-82M-4bit — do not use. The governed route is voice:generate_voice with engine_id kokoro + params.voice passthrough; ad-hoc mlx_audio CLI is scratch-only. Pipeline: knowledge/product/pipeline-templates/narrated-explainer-video.json; playbook: knowledge/product/orchestration/japanese-voiceover-production-playbook.md; backend record: knowledge/product/governance/media-backends/voice.mlx_audio_kokoro.json.
